properties.name: 17/02405/FULL
properties.notes: 5-15 House Supply. Continued use as public house (Use Class A4) at basement and ground floors and conversion of upper floors into six residential units. Roof extension to existing building. Erection of five storey mixed-use building over beer garden restating Class A4 use at ground floor level and provision of four residential units on upper floors. Demolition of pub garden outbuildings and boundary wall to Harrow Road.
